text: You are the program manager of a complex program in a risk adverse company; during the kick-off meeting, a lot of employees moved out of the room as they were not interested in the change being proposed. What is your next course of action?
choices: A. Escalate to steering committee
B. Do nothing, as the functional managers are responsible for employees
C. Consult with the functional managers, do root-cause analysis and take appropriate actions
D. Escalate to functional manager

text: Your operations manager is always asking about what will happen after the warranty period ends. You are currently in the closing stage and you want to make sure that the program is sustained after transition to operations. Which of the below may be required to oversee ongoing benefits?
choices: A. Post-transition meeting to get feedback
B. Post-transition meeting to document lessons learned
C. Check if there are any required residual activities
D. Final Performance review

text: Throughout the course of the program, the program manager and governance board work to ensure benefits realization within the program scope and company standards. B. Architecture
C. Benefits management plan
D. Benefits register

text: You have a complex program and components in different countries. Each component is using a different architectural pattern; some are using waterfall and other agile. Components also are spanned across different cultures. What should you consider in this case?

B. Define measurement criteria for each constituent project based on the country and culture
C. Instruct the project managers to define measurement criteria each for his/her own project
D. Define standard measurement criteria for all constituent projects across all countries

text: During the course of the program, the program manager continuously tries to optimize benefits in order to maximize the benefits delivery. Which of the below warrants realizing more benefits?

B. Exploit
C. Share
D. Transfer

text: During the course of the program, the program manager continuously tries to optimize benefits in order to maximize the benefits delivery. Which of the below warrants maximizing benefits?
choices: A. Enhance
B. Exploit
C. Share
D. Transfer

text: You are in the definition phase of your 5-years program to build a subway to link three major cities in your country. You are currently preparing the business case and doing comparative advantage, which of the below is useful in this case?
choices: A. SWOT analysis
B. What-if analysis
C. Sensitivity analysis
D. Feasibility study

text: You have delivered your program successfully to the operations. D. Program manager and operation manager

text: You are defining program components and are looking for project managers to manage these components. B. Conflict resolution skills
C. Communication skills

text: Consider you are on the portfolio steering committee and choosing a program to undertake. You want to choose the most viable program, which requires you to check?

B. Program Roadmap
C. Program business case
D. Strategic plan

text: You are in the definition phase of your 5-years program to build a subway to link three major cities in your country. Your program is critical to the government as the congestion rate along with the stress rates have been affecting the growth of the country. In order to obtain initial validation and approval from the executive sponsor, you
choices: A. Define program charter

C. Define business case

text: You are mid-way through your program and due to changes; you realize the need to integrate two new components in order to realize expected benefits. Which of the following documents establishes the linkage of the new components to the already defined program components?
choices: A. Program charter
B. Program roadmap
C. Program scope statement

You monitor the business environment, program functionality requirements, and benefits realization in order to ensure
choices: A. Continue to the next phase

text: Throughout the course of the program, the program manager works to realize benefits within the constraints he/she has. choices: A. Face to face meeting
B. Focus groups

B. Impact

choices: A. The communication strategy
